name: subtitler-extension-isolated
description: Overlay SRT/VTT subtitles onto any HTML5 video and find them online, with no server of our own.

scripts.package:chrome: vite build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir release --filename subtitler-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir release --filename subtitler-firefox-{version}.xpi --overwrite-dest
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && vite build && node tools/verify-build.mjs && vite build --mode firefox && node tools/verify-build.mjs --firefox
